title: 第832章 丧尽天良逆天而行第831章 你有没有发现叶天澜对邪魔越来越残忍了
slug: 三天大成了绝世剑仙童养夫
content_zh:
血雾在夜风中迅速消散，原地只剩下一件空荡荡的长袍和几件零碎的法器掉落在地，还有那个砸在地上裂开了一道缝的玉匣。
除此之外，什么都没剩下。
演武场上安静得能听见夜风卷过碎石的声音。
青鸾宗七人，有一个算一个，全都傻了。
他们瞪大了眼睛，直愣愣地盯着那件空荡荡的长袍，脑子像是被什么东西狠狠砸了一下，半天转不过弯来。
殷护法死了。
就这么简单干脆利落的死了。
不是应该讨价还价的吗？
不是应该拿出更多筹码来换命的吗？
哪怕再不济，也应该被关起来、被审问、被搜魂，至少还能多苟活一阵子。
结果就这么窝囊的死了。
众人脸色白得跟鬼一样，嘴唇哆哆嗦嗦地上下碰，碰了半天什么都没说出来。
姜玄跪在最前面，额头抵着冰冷的青石板，后背的衣袍早已经被冷汗湿透了。
他能感觉到那道平静的目光正落在自己身上。
不重，也没有杀意，但他浑身上下的每一块骨头都在打颤。
他之前还觉得这个人是个废物，是个连法相后期傀儡都打不过的泥腿子。
现在那个“泥腿子”就站在他面前，眼皮都没眨一下就弄死了一个紫府境的护法。
一个连他都需要仰望的存在。
却连讨价还价的机会都没给，就像一只随手被碾死的蚂蚁。
而接下来轮到谁了——

他心里比谁都清楚。
“姜兄。”
头顶传来那个平淡的声音，语气跟之前在演武场上寒暄的时候一模一样。
姜玄浑身一抖，几乎是本能地把头磕得更低了。
“大人！我说！我什么都说！我绝不敢有半句隐瞒！”
叶天澜低头看着他，没说话。
姜玄也不敢抬头，就那么跪在地上，声音发抖地开始交代。
“我们青鸾宗和血魂宗之间的交易，是从一年多之前开始的。”
“那时候噬魂邪魔刚刚潜入赤耀联邦，找到了血魂宗，提出要用活人神魂来培育母蛭。”
“血魂宗一开始不敢答应，但那邪魔开的价码太高了。”
“每一批母蛭吞噬完之后凝聚出的精魂核心，邪魔只取三成，剩下七成全归血魂宗。”
“一枚核心就足以让一个法相巅峰的修士冲击半步紫府，几十枚核心就能堆出一个真正的紫府境强者出来。”
“血魂宗没扛住这个天大的诱惑，答应了。”
他咽了口唾沫，声音又低了几分。
“但母蛭的成长需要大量活人神魂，血魂宗虽然控制了方圆百万里，可如果大张旗鼓地屠城灭镇，迟早会被其他势力发现。”
“所以他们一开始只是在偏远的地方下手，挑那些偏僻的村镇，一个村子一个村子地吞。”
“可噬魂母蛭的胃口太大了，一次吞噬就要成千上万人，偏远村镇根本不够它们吃的。”
content_en:
The blood mist quickly dissipated in the night wind, leaving only an empty robe and a few fragmentary magic weapons falling to the ground, as well as the jade box that cracked a crack on the ground.
Beyond that, nothing remains.
The martial arts arena was so quiet that one could hear the sound of the night wind blowing through the gravel.
Every one of the seven members of the Qingluan Sect was stunned.
Their eyes widened and they stared blankly at the empty robe, as if their brains had been hit hard by something, and they couldn't turn around for a long time.
Protector Yin is dead.
It was that simple and a neat death.
Aren’t you supposed to bargain?
Shouldn't we give more chips in exchange for our lives?
No matter how bad it is, he should be locked up, interrogated, and soul-searched, so that he can at least survive for a while.
As a result, he died so cowardly.
Everyone's faces were as white as ghosts, their lips were trembling and they were touching each other up and down, but they didn't say anything for a long time.
Jiang Xuan knelt at the front, his forehead pressed against the cold bluestone, and the robe on his back was already soaked with cold sweat.
He could feel that calm gaze falling on him.
It wasn't heavy, and it didn't have killing intent, but every bone in his body was trembling.
He had previously thought that this person was a waste, a mud-legged person who couldn't even beat the puppets of the later stage of Dharma.
Now that "mud-legged man" was standing in front of him, and he killed a Purple Mansion Realm protector without blinking an eyelid.
An existence that even he needs to look up to.
But he didn't even give him a chance to bargain, just like an ant being crushed to death.
And whose turn is it next——
He knows it better than anyone else.
"Brother Jiang."
The plain voice came from above the head, and the tone was exactly the same as when they were chatting on the martial arts field.
Jiang Xuan trembled all over and almost instinctively knocked his head lower.
"Sir! I'll tell you! I'll tell you everything! I won't dare to hide anything!"
Ye Tianlan looked down at him and said nothing.
Jiang Xuan didn't dare to raise his head, he just knelt on the ground and began to explain in a trembling voice.
"The transaction between our Qingluan Sect and the Blood Soul Sect started more than a year ago."
"At that time, the soul-eating evil demon had just sneaked into the Red Yao Federation, found the Blood Soul Sect, and proposed to use the souls of living people to cultivate mother leeches."
"The Blood Soul Sect didn't dare agree at first, but the price offered by the evil devil was too high."
"After each batch of mother leeches are devoured, the evil spirit only takes 30% of the essence core condensed, and the remaining 70% goes to the Blood Soul Sect."
"One core is enough to allow a monk at the peak of Dharma to attack the Zifu half step, and dozens of cores can make a true Zifu realm strongman emerge."
"The Blood Soul Sect didn't resist this huge temptation and agreed."
He swallowed and his voice became a little lower.
"But the growth of Mother Leech requires a large number of living souls. Although the Blood Soul Sect controls a million-mile radius, if it massacres cities and towns in a big way, it will be discovered by other forces sooner or later."
"So they only started in remote places at first, picking out remote villages and towns, and annexed them one by one."
"But the appetite of soul-eating mother leeches is too big. It can devour thousands of people at a time. There is simply not enough food for them in remote villages and towns."
